# doc-bricks MediaBrain

Canonical repository: https://github.com/doc-bricks/MediaBrain

## Summary

MediaBrain is a local-first PySide6 desktop application for managing personal media history, local files, streaming-provider entries, favorites, blacklists, tags, and smart playlists. It stores data locally in SQLite databases and configuration files. It has no telemetry, no tracking, and no automatic cloud sync.

## Primary Audience

- Users who want a private local media hub
- Developers looking for a PySide6 desktop media-library example
- Maintainers evaluating doc-bricks local-first desktop tools

## Key Files

- `README.md` - English public landing page
- `README_de.md` - German public landing page
- `PRIVACY_POLICY.md` - privacy boundaries and optional metadata calls
- `ARCH.md` - architecture overview
- `MediaBrain.py` - desktop application entry point
- `version.py` - canonical MediaBrain Desktop release version
- `cli.py` - official read-only command line interface
- `core.py` - media, tags, playlists, blacklist, and database logic
- `providers.py` - streaming and local-provider detection
- `gui.py` and `gui_playlists.py` - PySide6 user interface
- `store_package/MediaBrain/AppxManifest.xml` - canonical Windows Store AppxManifest
- `store_package.json` - package manifest and Store release configuration
- `STORE_LISTING.md` - bilingual Microsoft Store listing copy and feature index
- `SUPPORT.md` - bilingual user support and security guidance
- `scripts/check_store_readiness.py` - Store readiness preflight and release gate audit tool
- `tests/` - pytest regression, asset, and GUI smoke tests
- `tests/test_store_materials.py` - packaging and metadata contract tests
- `tests/test_app_assets.py` - icon resolution and store screenshot validation
- `tests/test_repo_metadata.py` - repository metadata, version parity, and badges validation
- `tests/source_platform_smoke.py` - Ubuntu/macOS source and offscreen-GUI contract
- `.github/workflows/source-platform-smoke.yml` - real Ubuntu/macOS CI runners

## Boundaries

MediaBrain is not a streaming service, not a cloud sync product, not an advertising/media-planning analytics platform, not the MediaBrain-SJTU research organization, and not an AI media generator. Optional metadata lookup depends on user-configured API keys or public metadata services.
